name: Water-lily Leaf Beetle
desc: Water-lily Leaf Beetle (Galerucella nymphaeae): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Galerucella nymphaeae, known generally as the water-lily beetle or water lily leaf beetle, is a species of skeletonizing leaf beetle in the family Chrysomelidae.
